notes.title: Famousity available now!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31461319/03e24843687c96a912df451365e29ab7fe78e760.png[/img]

[h1]HI AND WELCOME[/h1]
It's time and we would like to welcome you into the Famousity universe, where famous people from history meet each other to form legendary teams.

[h1]HOW TO ENJOY[/h1]
When you play the game the first time we strongly advice you to play tutorial - "HOW TO PLAY" in menu item, which will explain all the navigation and most importantly the game rules. After finishing it, you should be able to understand basic strategies of how to create groups and how to score points to win matches. You can then choose to play against the bots ("PLAY WITH BOTS") or you can directly jump into the games with other players - "FIND GAME". Lobby will be created as soon as another player(s) is found. In the lobby you can wait for other players (up to 4 players) or you can play with the players currently in. In such case just set yourself as "READY". When all the players in the lobby are set as "READY" your match will start.
If you have friends you want to play with, you can use "CREATE GAME" to create a lobby and invite your friends into the game. You can use "PUBLISH" to set the lobby public so also strangers can join you.
Don't forget to check your "DAILY CHALLENGES", so you can gain some additional points ;)

[h1]TELL US WHAT YOU THINK[/h1]
This is our first game and we would love to hear your feedback, so we can improve the game further. Your review (either positive or negative) is much appreciated, so we can prepare updates in the way, that is most relevant for you to have fun with the game ;)

[h1]WHEN SOMETHING GOES WRONG[/h1]
As we are not perfect nor are our creations and Famousity can contain a bugs or other issues, which were not found during our test rounds. If you experience anything, please don't hesitate to post it [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/733030/discussions/5]here[/url]. We are here to fix it as soon as humanly possible.

[h1]GOOD LUCK, HAVE FUN!!![/h1]
Remember, you don't have to win every match. Winning only gives you additional bonus, so just focus on tuning your strategies, collecting cards and groups and HAVING FUN ;)
If you followed our social media campaign ([url=https://www.facebook.com/Famousity-Game-364856867270501/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/FamousityGame]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/famousitygame]Instagram[/url]) you know, that we like to create funny dialogues of people who could meet in the Famousity universe. Let everyone see how funny and creative you are and create some funny dialogues yourself [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/733030/discussions/6]here[/url]. Or upload a screenshot from your gallery ;)

[b]Famousity Team[/b]

notes.title: Update 0.6.0 - PRERELEASE
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31461319/d426c97d6a93ab3febdd5834e173910f45450c8a.png[/img]

[h1]RELEASE IS JUST BEHIND THE CORNER[/h1]
Everything is ready and set for our grand launch. During the last two weeks we have been mostly working on testing and bugfixing, polishing and promoting the game. We believe that during the last weeks we have attracted many players who will enjoy Famousity and we will have awesome start on Tuesday, April 3rd.

[h1]SERVER MIGRATION AND DATABASE WIPE[/h1]
We have moved to a better production server which will ensure thousands of concurrently running matches, which should me more than enough :D
We would like to thank all the people that helped us during the past several months with the testing. During that time database has collected lot of data which much of it is obsolete and we will perform wipe, to clear everything (even leaderboard), which also gives our new players a fresh start and the chance to fight for the top spot in the leaderboard. Although those of you who already have access to the game can start to build up some lead :)

[h1]THE MORE, THE BETTER[/h1]
Playing Famousity with other people, whether with friends or strangers is much fun, so don't forget the spread the word about the upcoming release. See you then with our official release ;)

[b]Famousity Team[/b]

notes.title: Update 0.5.3
notes.content:
[h1]MATCHMAKING AND AI IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
While Famousity is definitely more fun when played with friends or strangers, it is also important to have solid AI, in cases there is not enough other players you can play with or you just want to practice. Or maybe you just prefer to play against computer ;)
Our bots are now more challenging. We plan to go further and add more rules, so they are even harder to beat.

On the other hand our matchmaking needed some love and we have fixed some small issues, added chat to the lobby and improved waiting experience. Now, in case of long waiting times, you don't have to just sit and wait, but you can play with bots. When a match is found you will get notified and you can join the match with other players.

[b]Famousity Team[/b]

notes.title: Update 0.5.2
notes.content:
[h1]STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS[/h1]
To keep many of you motivated, we are proudly introducing several Steam Achievements you can start collecting. There are currently [b]9 categories[/b] of achievements while each having [b]6 levels[/b] based on number of count needed to unlock them.

[i]Categories[/i]
[list]
[*]Winner - number of won games
[*]Loser - number of lost games
[*]Team Leader - number of created groups
[*]Thief - number of stolen cards
[*]Destroyer - number of destroyed cards
[*]Negotiator - number of exchanged cards
[*]Friend Maker - number of created pairs
[*]Celebrity Triangulator - number of created threesomes
[*]History Representative - number of created straights
[/list]

[h1]ACTION SYMBOLS UPDATED[/h1]
Another small improvement is about card design and how action is presented on the card. We have updated our action symbol icons and its placement on the card.

notes.title: Update 0.5.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

As we are moving towards our release day, we have been busy making Famousity more "juicy" and polishing up graphics, sounds and music (so actually everything). Here is our exhausting list of changes:

- added challenge hints during a match
- added create group "black hole" effect
- added explosion effect for Discard action
- added winner and loser music
- improved card handling sounds (deal, play)
- added outlines to game texts for better visibility
- improved card selection outline graphics
- improved table leg graphics
- fixed gallery incorrect loading when changing categories

Thanks!!!

notes.title: Update 0.5.0
notes.content:
[h1]INTRODUCING GALLERY[/h1]
We are proud to introduce our next feature on the path to Famousity's economy - [b]Gallery[/b].

In the current implementation of Gallery you can browse all of your groups you have created so far and see what awesome parties have been created.

[b][u]People[/u][/b]
You can view all of your people you have collected so far.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31461319/237c850910885ed9d598e9ce37301382f1bc5741.jpg[/img]

When going to a person's details, you are able to see person's biography as happened in Famousity universe. Not all people have their bio ready currently, but we plan to add that for every person as the development goes on. If you want to help us with creating a (funny) bio, we are happy to credit you ;)
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31461319/df4fbe25c4b6d7fd8010504c1a908f1443922b7b.jpg[/img]

[b][u]Couples, Threesomes, Straights[/u][/b]
These sections contain list of groups you have created so far.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31461319/80de9884a84299709240e2ceee52683c76558d67.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31461319/c5d2b384d34e04e83960ee341d63ce2db87ded92.jpg[/img]

You can also view detail of a group.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31461319/797788689b1b6194e49f1f555f166aeaea8d9cf6.jpg[/img]

[h1]THE FUTURE OF GALLERY[/h1]
In the future, as the main concept of Famousity is to create legendary groups of famous people, you will be able to "sell" duplicated groups (created more than once) for GameCoins, which will be used to buy an extra (premium) content in the game.
As for the fun aspect of the game, you will be able to create a (funny) story for each group you own. Everyone will be able to see others' stories and upvote for any of them, which allows creator to gain some GameCoins.

Thank you for reading and don't forget to follow us on our social platforms:
[url=https://www.facebook.com/Famousity-Game-364856867270501]Facebook[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/FamousityGame]Twitter[/url]
[url=https://www.instagram.com/famousitygame]Instagram[/url]

Your [u]Famousity Team[/u].
